ns2:course.label: Theory Prac in Child Comp
ns2:course.description: Studies composition or writing, its beginning and progress, gives particular attention to the relationship between creativity and imagination and the basic skills of punctuation, spelling, and other conventions of writing; and examines research studies on functions of writing, motivation, and purposes for writing during the school years. Prerequisite: CI 475 & CI 476, or course in writing, or consent of instructor.
